patterns: Dominant shape: 'which is a direct / not an indirect tax' and taxable-event items (excise = production, customs = import/export).
APPSC also asks definitions (tax = compulsory pecuniary burden, no quid pro quo), Centre tax-GDP figure from Economic Survey (9.9% in 2019-20), early-planning dominance of indirect taxes.
Committee-to-subject recall: Kelkar (direct and indirect), Chelliah (tax reform), L.K. Jha (VAT/MODVAT); MODVAT/CENVAT = excise.
Union vs State levies (corporation tax Union; agricultural income, entertainment tax State) recur across PSCs.
App leans on 2026-27 Budget shares, buoyancy figures and AP own-tax data; more statement-combination items than PYQs show.
